capabilities: Answer questions about vault notes with links to the notes used
Draft a new note from a topic
Run prompt templates on a selection or note
Connect to hosted or local LLM providers
Insert, copy or save answers and chats as notes
extras: API keys are kept in Obsidian's secret storage; folders can be excluded from being read; requires Obsidian 1.11.4 or newer.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to ask questions across a vault and get answers that link back to the notes they came from.

relations.evidence: OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Groq, NVIDIA NIM, OpenRouter, local models and more.
Runs on your computer. Pull a model first, like ollama pull llama3.2
Runs on your computer. Turn on the local server in LM Studio

requires.name: LM Studio or Ollama for local models

summary: AI chat sidebar that answers questions from your notes with citations, drafts new notes, and runs prompt templates.
